players.product: Platinum Pro single-molecule protein sequencer and Proteus platform

quarterly_data.signal: World HUPO 2026 presentation (Proteus architecture and interim development results): the Proteus nanowell array is a simple, passive consumable with an estimated 80 million wells at launch versus the integrated semiconductor consumable with 2 million wells of Platinum Pro (40x more nanowell capacity per consumable); interim data show an 87.2% pass-filter rate versus 65.6% on Platinum, 21.2x median apertures per chamber and 1.41x more alignments per aperture. The company plans to complete development of new AI-based algorithms to deliver reference-free sequencing and generalizable PTM detection in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: estimated 80 million wells vs 2 million; 40x nanowell capacity; 87.2% vs 65.6% pass filter
